body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> BlackBerry devices have become today's solution to stay connected and OtterBox is an ideal solution for keeping these expensive devices protected. With cases for the Bold, 8700 Series and coming soon for the Curve 8350i and the Storm, OtterBox offers unsurpassed protection for all BlackBerry users.
